# w.scrpt 0.1.0 RC20 checkpoint

Date: 2026-07-28

Worktree: `/path/to/wscrpt`

## Scope

RC20 adds a keyboard-first recent-files/session navigation view for iPad/Blink use without introducing a permanent sidebar.

- `Esc w e` opens the Recent Files view.
- `:recent`, `:recent-files`, and `:recentfiles` open the same view.
- Recent file-backed paths are retained as path-only session/navigation context.
- The retained list is bounded to 128 paths.
- The view is read-only and shows active/open markers plus disk state (`file`, `other`, or `missing`).
- Viewing recent files does not open missing files, read file contents, restore paths, mutate buffers, or change the active source buffer.
- Session restore carries recent file-backed paths as navigation context while still restoring only available open file-backed buffers.
- `:w`, `:w PATH`, `:w!`, `:wq`, quick-open, tree open, search result open, LSP/problem/jump opens, and save-as routes refresh the recent-file list when they resolve a file-backed source.

## Proof boundary

This checkpoint is locally verified on the host Rust/PTY path. It is not a real iPad Magic Keyboard, Blink Shell, mosh, SSH, tmux, clipboard, touch, reconnect, or real language-server proof. Those remain manual QA gates in `docs/IPAD_BLINK_QA.md`.
